Lalaloopsy - Carnival of Friends.name: Lalaloopsy: Carnival of Friends
Lalaloopsy - Carnival of Friends.summary: Peanut Big Top is throwing the biggest Silly Funhouse carnival in Lalaloopsy Land for all to enjoy, including a special treat at the end! It's up to you to find all of the Lalaloopsy friends at the carnival to reveal the BIG surprise!

Regular Show - Mordecai & Rigby in 8-Bit.name: Regular Show: Mordecai and Rigby in 8-Bit Land
Regular Show - Mordecai & Rigby in 8-Bit.summary: Regular Show: Mordecai and Rigby in 8-Bit Land has players help Mordecai and Rigby use their best skills and unique abilities to traverse the various challenges to escape their favorite video games and get home.
